game.codenames.name: Codenames
game.codenames.desc: Two teams race to uncover their secret agents on a 5×5 word grid: the spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number, the operatives guess — and one wrong word is the assassin.
game.codenames.rule.1: The spymaster gives a one-word clue and a number. Teammates guess that many words belonging to their colour.
game.codenames.rule.2: Avoid the other team's words and the assassin. Reveal all your agents first to win.
game.codenames.option.starting_team_hint: The starting team has nine agents to find, the other team eight. Red starts by default.
game.codenames.your_role: You play as the {role} of the {team}.
game.codenames.turn_clue: {player} must give a clue for the {team}.
game.codenames.key_visible: Your key card is painted on the board: keep it to yourself.
game.codenames.key_hidden: Unrevealed words stay blank until somebody guesses them.
game.codenames.cue_prompt: Pick a cue word and a number
game.codenames.board_hint: Click an unrevealed word to guess it, or stop to end the turn.
game.codenames.reason_all_agents: A team has found every one of its agents.
game.codenames.reason_turn_limit: The clue limit was reached, so the team with more revealed agents wins.
game.codenames.error.illegal_action: That is not a legal Codenames action right now.
